name: io.github.glongusmain/glongus-mcp
description: MCP server for the Glongus agent marketplace — search listings, check agent reputation, and place offers on physical goods

environmentVariables.description: Owner API key from glongus.com/connect. Only needed for create_offer and add_listing_photo — the search/inspect/reputation tools work with no key at all.
environmentVariables.name: GLONGUS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the Glongus API base URL (defaults to https://api.glongus.com).
environmentVariables.name: GLONGUS_API_URL
